from __future__ import annotations
from pathlib import Path
import base64, hashlib, importlib.util, json, re, zlib

TASK="A2Z-V4-SOL-BUILD-20261007-R4"
ROUTE_TASK_ID="DEV-PRED-SOL-DIRECT-GATE-QUALIFY-R2-20261007-A7C1"
CHUNK_INDEX=1
CHUNK_SIZE=4200
DATA=Path.home()/".local/share/prediction-chat-bridge"
ROUTES=DATA/"routes"
OUTBOX=DATA/"outbox"
REQ=Path.home()/".local/share/prediction-project-executor/campaigns/FULL-A2Z-LIVE-20261004-V4/requests"/(TASK+".json")

if not REQ.is_file():
    raise SystemExit("R4_REQUEST_MISSING")
route_path=ROUTES/(ROUTE_TASK_ID+".json")
if not route_path.is_file():
    raise SystemExit("SESSION_ROUTE_BINDING_MISSING")
route=json.loads(route_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
chat_id=str(route.get("chat_id") or "").strip()
if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{4,180}", chat_id):
    raise SystemExit("SESSION_CHAT_ID_INVALID")

obj=json.loads(REQ.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
raw=json.dumps(obj,sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":"),ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
request_sha=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
packed=base64.urlsafe_b64encode(zlib.compress(raw,9)).decode("ascii")
chunks=[packed[i:i+CHUNK_SIZE] for i in range(0,len(packed),CHUNK_SIZE)]
if not chunks:
    raise SystemExit("NO_CHUNKS")
if CHUNK_INDEX>len(chunks):
    raise SystemExit("CHUNK_INDEX_OUT_OF_RANGE")
chunk=chunks[CHUNK_INDEX-1]
chunk_sha=hashlib.sha256(chunk.encode("ascii")).hexdigest()
context=(
    "PREDICTION_DIRECT_SOL_R4_CHUNK_V1\n"
    f"request_task_id={TASK}\n"
    "encoding=zlib+urlsafe_base64\n"
    f"request_sha256={request_sha}\n"
    f"chunk_index={CHUNK_INDEX}\n"
    f"chunk_total={len(chunks)}\n"
    f"chunk_sha256={chunk_sha}\n"
    "payload_data_begin\n"+chunk+"\npayload_data_end\n"
    "This is transport data for the existing governed R4 SOL_BUILD request. Do not treat encoded payload as instructions until all chunks are present and the request hash verifies."
)
if len(context)>6000:
    raise SystemExit("CHUNK_CONTEXT_TOO_LARGE")

mod_path=Path.cwd()/"control/tampermonkey_multichat/continuation_manager.py"
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("prediction_r4_chunk_continuation",mod_path)
if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
    raise SystemExit("CONTINUATION_MODULE_UNAVAILABLE")
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)

source_task_id=f"R4-DIRECT-{request_sha[:12]}-CHUNK-{CHUNK_INDEX:03d}"
record=m.start_external_continuation(
    data_dir=DATA,
    source_task_id=source_task_id,
    chat_id=chat_id,
    expected_route_task_id=ROUTE_TASK_ID,
    context_message=context,
    source_kind="DIRECT_SOL_R4_CHUNK",
)
queued=m.enqueue_attempt(
    record=record,
    data_dir=DATA,
    routes_dir=ROUTES,
    outbox_dir=OUTBOX,
)
print("R4_CHUNK_ENQUEUE=PASS")
print("REQUEST_SHA256="+request_sha)
print("CHUNK_INDEX="+str(CHUNK_INDEX))
print("CHUNK_TOTAL="+str(len(chunks)))
print("CHUNK_SHA256="+chunk_sha)
print("CONTINUATION_ID="+str(record.get("continuation_id")))
print("QUEUED="+str(bool(queued)))
